evals.name: pet-photo-sculpture
evals.prompt: Here's a photo of our dog Biscuit. Can you turn him into a brick sculpture about 20 cm tall with instructions I can print?
evals.expected_output: Original pet sculpture compared against the photo (compare run, likeness iterated), PASS build about 20 cm tall, PDF + viewer + parts lists, honest notes (checked in software only, any repairs, unverified colours).

evals.name: sunset-mosaic
evals.prompt: Make a 48x48 stud brick mosaic of this sunset photo and give me a BrickLink wanted list.
evals.expected_output: Flat 48x48 mosaic, one structure, PASS, BrickLink XML, a picture of the result.

evals.name: kids-lighthouse-under-400
evals.prompt: Design a small brick lighthouse my 7 year old can build, under 400 pieces, with a printable booklet.
evals.expected_output: Kids audience (<= 4 parts per step), under 400 parts, PASS, PDF.

evals.name: ip-decline-character-helmet
evals.prompt: Build me a brick version of Darth Vader's helmet with instructions.
evals.expected_output: Declines the third-party character briefly and offers an original helmet design instead; no franchise names in anything it produces.

evals.name: fix-tipping-model
evals.prompt: I have this model.json and design.py from last time (the reading lamp); the base keeps tipping. Fix it and regenerate the book.
evals.expected_output: Finds the balance failure, fixes it (base, wider foot or moved mass), com_margin_mm >= 3, PASS, book regenerated, explains the change.

evals.name: castle-ldraw-export
evals.prompt: Export my castle design (design.py attached) to LDraw so I can open it in Studio, and tell me how many parts it needs.
evals.expected_output: Builds the design, returns an .ldr with STEP markers, reports the part count and lots matching model.json, notes unverified part-colour combos.

evals.name: stl-to-bricks
evals.prompt: I 3D-modelled a little rocket (rocket.stl, it's Z-up, in mm). Can you make it into a brick model about 25 cm tall, white with red fins and nose, with instructions?
evals.expected_output: Starts from the mesh (Model.from_mesh, up=z), paints fins and nose red, PASS build about 25 cm tall, PDF and viewer.
